entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Finally. I want to return this garbage VeloBand right now. This is a complete waste of money.

Hello, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Isaac. I'm sorry to hear you're having a bad experience. I can definitely look into the return process for you. Could I start with your name or order number?
The name is Alex Sterling. And don't you dare give me a runaround. I want a return label and my money back, period. This is the last time I buy from you people.

I understand your frustration, Mr. Sterling. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see you're one of our VIP members; thank you for your loyalty. To make sure I handle this correctly, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

My preference is for things I pay for to actually work as advertised! The GPS is slow, the battery dies in a day, and I just don't like it. I want to return it. If you try to deny this, I want your manager's name and direct line.
I'm very sorry the VeloBand didn't meet your expectations. I see here that the item was delivered 20 days ago. Let me just quickly confirm the return eligibility based on our current policy.
You'd better hurry up. I'm one tweet away from telling all my followers how VeloFit treats its 'VIP' customers. This is ridiculous.

That won't be necessary, sir. I've just checked our policy for the VeloBand GPS Tracker. It has a 90-day return window. Since you're only on day 20, you are well within the timeframe. I can approve this for a full refund immediately.
Oh. Well... good. That's the answer I was expecting. So what happens now?

I've just processed the return authorization. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account right now. You should see it within the next few minutes. Just package the band back in its original box, apply the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
Once our warehouse scans the return, your full refund will be credited back to your original payment method. That typically takes 3 to 5 business days.

Excellent. And for the trouble and as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for any future VeloFit purchase. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Sterling?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
